page: OVHcloud d2-8 is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the Discovery family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor (Haswell, no TSX) running at 2.0 GHz. The configuration includes 4 vCPUs with shared CPU allocation, 4 physical cores, and 1.0 thread per core. Memory capacity is 8.0 GB, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a 50 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate entry-level performance characteristics. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 917.98 falls in the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 3730.94 is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show 322.39 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 35.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, both placing in the bottom 25%. Cryptographic and decompression workloads also reflect these constraints, with a PassMark CPU encryption score of 949.1 and a single-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 6.92 GB/sec.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest benchmark scores, this server offers a highly cost-efficient option for non-production environments. The resource density and hardware profile make it suitable for lightweight workloads such as static web serving, basic Redis caching, development environments, and minor database operations. It is not designed for resource-intensive applications, high-throughput networking, or heavy computational tasks.
